scope: Exactly the 30 top-level .v files in TOY and MAJ. Original source bytes are the authority; v1 arithmetic corrections are not substituted.

measurement.method: normalize_verilog(default source_order=False), then actual ifcn_agent_backend.py parse in compact and layered modes, temporary outputs only; no P&R or paid model calls.
measurement.gate_nodes: AND/OR/NOT Boolean nodes in the normalized parsed DAG; excludes input and wire/buffer nodes. This frontend lowers majority expressions to AOI gates.
measurement.non_input_nodes: All parsed nodes except primary inputs, including wire/buffer nodes.
measurement.nodes: All effective nodes including inputs and wire/buffers. Parser counts are not final native P&R candidate counts.
measurement.truth_table_sha256_encoding: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(truth_table, separators=(comma, colon)); rows follow lexicographic 0-before-1 input declaration order; output columns follow output declaration order.
measurement.classification_limit: Exact fixed declaration-order truth tables only; not NPN equivalence or a claim of independent application circuits.

optimization_limits.eligibility_note: Actual optimization additionally requires an irregular Compact/June baseline and fresh RTL/clock/physical certificates. Final candidate node/route counts govern eligibility, not these parse-only measurements.

changes.description: Use low-bit generate for the carry into bit 1.
Use the intermediate carry when computing final carry-out.
Align module header with the existing scalar input declarations a,b; assign logic is unchanged.

recursive_derivatives_excluded.policy: Generated subdirectory source variants and RL parser-safe copies are excluded from top-level benchmark membership and independent-test counts.

cases.semantic_note: Original source preserved. It differs from the corrected unsigned two-bit adder in v1 on 12 of 32 input vectors; source equivalence does not establish the intended arithmetic specification.

header_warnings: Legacy module header differs from input/output declarations; normalized ports follow the declarations. Original source preserved.
